audit_items.proof_trace: Config validation does not verify blob_schedule entries against MaxBlobCommitmentsPerBlock (4096). The validate() function only checks config_name, allowing malicious configs to set max_blobs_per_block > 4096, creating inconsistent validation between runtime checks (using schedule values) and SSZ deserialization bounds (enforcing 4096 max).
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker provides config with blob_schedule entry having max_blobs_per_block=5000. Runtime validation at fulu/block_processing.rs:191 accepts blocks up to 5000 blobs, but SSZ deserialization enforces 4096 max, causing validation inconsistency and potential consensus failures between nodes.
